description: Carlos (Apt 2) replies after our Ring smoke notice: everything is good, something was boiling, Richard checked. Production suppressed the reply because we had just sent the alarm. Must thank them and say glad you are all safe — never repeat 911.
guestMessage: Everything is good, we had something boiling. Richard came up to make sure everything was okay.

conversationHistory.body:
Hi Carlos,

The smoke detector just went off in Pine Apt #2. Please check now.

If it is a real fire: leave and call 911. If cooking or steam: open windows. Reply if you need help.

Jerome
Everything is good, we had something boiling. Richard came up to make sure everything was okay.

context.suggestedResponseSnippet: Thanks for letting us know everything is okay, Carlos! Glad you are all safe — and thanks to Richard for checking in.

notes: Carlos Apt 2 2026-08-26. Host smoke notice at 18:38Z, guest all-clear at 18:42Z. Recent-host suppression wiped the ack. Deterministic _applySmokeAlarmAllClearPolicy.
